name: Universal Feminine Traits
tagline: The immutable core. These do not change with age, injury, or extreme training.
body: The traits Nereid guarantees at baseline and restores after any deviation. A profile never needs to restate them; a profile that contradicts one is a contradiction, not a variant.
rules: Feminine face — smoothed jaw, soft cheeks, refined brows
Soft skin, minimal hair, blushes easily
